meta.title: Green Ecolution
meta.description: Smart green space management for liveable cities.

title.statement: Smart green space management for liveable cities

quote.statement: We water and hope for the best.

water.body: is what Flensburg puts on its urban trees each year, with no data to go on and plenty of manual work on site.

sensor.statement: The soil says when to water.
sensor.body: Soil moisture, temperature and water tension at three depths, measured at 30, 60 and 90 centimetres.

lorawan.body: Green Ecolution builds on the state-wide network of Schleswig-Holstein with more than 420 gateways instead of running its own.

map.statement: One look at the map is enough.
map.body: A traffic light system shows which green spaces need water.

history.statement: Time series instead of gut feeling
history.body: Real readings from the soil, from ten sites in Flensburg since May 2026.

planning.body: Combine vehicles, teams and tree groups into one watering plan.

tour.body: Water capacity, refill points, vehicle size and access restrictions all feed into the route. Export as GPX for standard navigation devices.

inspection.statement: The state of every tree, right on site.
inspection.body: Staff see on the tablet which tree needs water, and log the watering right away.

team.statement: Born at Flensburg University of Applied Sciences.
team.body: Developed to production readiness by PROGEEK GmbH, in pilot operation with TBZ Flensburg.

open-source.body: Funded by the state of Schleswig-Holstein through “Offene Innovation: Open Source made in SH”. In pilot operation with TBZ Flensburg.
open-source.source: Flensburg University of Applied Sciences · PROGEEK · Smarte Grenzregion · City of Flensburg

demo.body: Map, sensor history and planning are waiting on the demo instance.
